items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She loves me. She’s a good lady. She’s a really good lady. I was very proud to be a part of her Legends Ball.

ctx.x: She loves me. She’s a good lady. She’s a really good lady. I was very proud to be a part of her Legends Ball. And she also does very good work. She’s a good – she’s got a big heart. Not just a good heart. She’s got a big heart, and she is always there. When it matters, when it’s important, she – and she does good stuff. She put out some decent movies, and she put [out] the plays. Not just the television show. I’m anxious to see what OWN [Oprah Winfrey Network] is going to be, how the news network show is going to…
Since we’re in media and black women, Cathy Hughes.
